name: Lag Reducer
description: Configurable particle workload optimization with strength levels 0-10.

enabled.name: Enable particle optimization
enabled.description: Master switch. Turn off to restore normal particle drawing.

particle-draw-reduction.name: Particle optimization strength
particle-draw-reduction.description: 0 = off; 1-10 reduce particle drawing, and levels 4+ also batch particle updates. Strong settings may make effects flicker or look choppy.
